backend/main.mo: Empty actor definition with no logic.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence file listing intermittent fasting dashboard features, related files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-style text summarizing multiple frontend files and their purposes.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base/styles defining OKLCH color variables and dark-mode theming.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point forcing dark mode and loading the main React bundle.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app wrapper applying dark theme, language provider, and rendering StartDashboard with Toaster.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Factor: Interactive factor card with icon, description, and helix connection line supporting selection state.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Interm: Fasting panel rendering status, timer, progress, KPIs, streak, and insights using timer and metric utilities.
frontend/src/components/genome/AnimatedH: SVG-based animated DNA helix background with gradients, glow filters, and breathing animations.
frontend/src/components/genome/HelixSpin: Renders a decorative animated DNA helix background and a container for child marker components.
frontend/src/components/i18n/LanguageSwi: Provides a button to toggle between English and German using the i18n context.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user's Internet Identity, refreshing dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useFastingWindowTimer: Computes real-time fasting/eating phase timing for a 16:8 schedule, updating every second.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements context and provider for managing Internet Identity login, persistence, and status.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Placeholder file for future React Query hooks.
frontend/src/i18n/LanguageProvider.tsx: Provides language state, persistence, and translation access via React context.
frontend/src/i18n/translations.ts: Defines English and German translation dictionaries and typing for i18n content.
frontend/src/i18n/useI18n.ts: Returns the active language context and translations, throwing if used outside the provider.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and color variables, including genome-specific themes for light and dark modes.
frontend/src/lib/fastingMetrics.ts: Provides demo fasting summaries and streak data for daily, weekly, and current streak metrics.
frontend/src/lib/timeFormat.ts: Utility functions for formatting durations and hours for fasting displays.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Defines a cn helper that merges class names using clsx and tailwind-merge.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers and renders the root component.
frontend/src/pages/StartDashboard.tsx: Implements the main dashboard page with DNA-themed visuals, factor markers, i18n text, and selectable factor logic.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind theme extensions, colors, fonts, animations, and plugins used across the frontend.
project_state.json: Describes the project state and feature requirements for a data-oriented Intermittent Fasting dashboard section.
